landscape.label: Local Business Spotlight
title: Deery Brothers
Ford
landscape.say: Local business spotlight: Deery Brothers Ford, Iowa City's hometown Ford dealer. Here's co-owner Tyler Eads.

landscape.label: Meet the Owner
landscape.title: “People just want to be respected.”

bullets.t: In and out in 90 minutes or less
No haggling over dollars and cents

landscape.say: People just want to be respected, they want transparency, and they want their time respected. They want to be in and out in 90 minutes or less, and they don't want to have to go back and forth and haggle over dollars and cents on their car deal.

landscape.label: Services
landscape.title: What Deery Brothers Ford does

cards.name: New Fords
cards.desc: Trucks, SUVs & EVs, from Escape to Super Duty

cards.name: Pre-owned & certified
cards.desc: Used trucks, SUVs & cars for every budget

cards.name: Pickup & delivery
cards.desc: Free Ford Pickup & Delivery for service

cards.name: Mobile service van
cards.desc: Oil changes, batteries & more, where you are

landscape.say: They sell new Ford trucks, SUVs and EVs, plus pre-owned and certified vehicles, with financing and trade-ins in-house. Their service center has factory-trained technicians and genuine Ford parts, with free Ford Pickup and Delivery, and a mobile service van that comes to you.

landscape.label: Meet the Owner
landscape.title: “Buying is the wedding. Owning is the marriage.”
landscape.say: The analogy I would use is when you're buying the car, that's really the wedding, and when you're owning the car, that ownership experience is the marriage itself.

landscape.label: Why Buy Here
landscape.title: Why buy at Deery Brothers
landscape.note: See dealer for complete warranty details and eligibility.
landscape.speak: Buy here and you get their lifetime coverage warranty, and used vehicles under a hundred thirty thousand miles get six months or six thousand miles. Plus, they're a Ford President's Award winner, one of just three hundred forty dealers nationwide.
landscape.say: Buy here and you get their lifetime coverage warranty, and used vehicles under 130,000 miles get six months or 6,000 miles. Plus, they're a Ford President's Award winner, one of just 340 dealers nationwide.

landscape.label: Meet the Owner
landscape.title: “Treated fairly, with respect.”
landscape.say: We may not have the largest selection or inventory of cars, but people know that they can come here and they're going to get treated fairly, with respect.

landscape.label: What Customers Say
landscape.title: What customers say

cards.text: Had such a phenomenal experience buying my first big girl car at Deery!! What can typically be a very intimidating process was made so easy.
cards.name: Elizabeth J.

cards.text: My salesman was prompt, professional, and so easy to work with. Overall, 6 out of 5 stars.
cards.name: Eric H.

cards.text: My truck broke down in the middle of a trip... He got us in right away and got us back on the road ASAP!!
cards.name: William P.

landscape.speak: Customers rate them four point eight stars on Google. Eric gave them six out of five stars, and when William's truck broke down mid-trip, they had him back on the road in about two hours.
landscape.say: Customers rate them 4.8 stars on Google. Eric gave them six out of five stars, and when William's truck broke down mid-trip, they had him back on the road in about two hours.
